paragraphs.text: The Tailor (original title Terzi) is a Turkish television series starring Çağatay Ulusoy, Salih Bademci, Şifanur Gül and Olgun Şimşek. The series is produced by OGM pictures and directed by Cem Karcı. The series premiered on 2 May 2023 on Netflix.

The series was initially going to be titled Süslü Korkuluk (Fancy Scarecrow) and broadcast on TV8 but Netflix became its eventual distributor. The series is based on a culmination of a psychiatrist's patient's experiences. It follows Peyami Dokumacı, a young and famous tailor who inherited talent and a successful business from his grandfather. With the death of his grandfather, Peyami brings his father Mustafa who is his biggest secret and has a child-like intelligence to his life in Istanbul and now has to take care of him without a soul finding out the truth.
